user.title: Connect your JK BMS units
user.description:
How are the BMS units connected?

**What you need:** a USB-RS485 adapter (preferably FTDI FT232R) or an RS485 network gateway, and a CAT5/6 cable cut open at one end: RJ45 **pin 1 = B (D−)**, **pin 2 = A (D+)**, **pin 3 = GND** (white-orange, orange, white-green).

**Where:** the free **RS485-2** (parallel) socket on the communication board of the first or last pack — not CAN / RS485-1, that one goes to the inverter. Every pack needs its own DIP address.

settings.title: Update interval
settings.description:
The interval is only used when Home Assistant polls the BMS units itself; with a master BMS (address 0) the master sets the pace.

**Allow changing BMS settings** adds switches (charge, discharge, balance) and the protection settings, and makes the settings card editable. Changes go straight into the BMS: only change what you understand. With a master BMS the integration sends a change in a quiet moment on the bus and checks that the BMS confirms it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Get a message on your phone (Home Assistant app) and/or in the HA notifications when something needs attention. Every message waits a moment first (cell difference 5 minutes, temperature 1 minute, offline 1 minute, different settings 10 minutes), so short spikes never wake you up. {count} notify service(s) available.

rescan.title: Search again
rescan.description: Pauses reading for up to 40 seconds and searches the bus. Use this after adding a pack or changing a DIP address. Packs that are not found stay, so a pack that is switched off is not lost.

dashboard.title: Create dashboard
dashboard.description: Adds a dashboard "Home battery" to the sidebar with the battery bank and every pack with its cells. Your own dashboards are never changed. Press again later to refresh it. {error}

no_bus.message: JK BMS Smart is not set up.

set_setting.name: Change BMS setting
set_setting.description: Writes one setting into one JK BMS, or into every pack of the bank (administrators only; 'Allow changing BMS settings' must be on).

entity_id.name: Pack
entity_id.description: Any JK BMS Smart entity of the pack.

value.name: Value
value.description: Volts, amps, Ah or °C; switches 1 = on, 0 = off.

all_packs.name: All packs
all_packs.description: Apply to every pack of the bank.

copy_settings.name: Make packs equal
copy_settings.description: Copies the protection and balancer settings of one pack to the other packs (administrators only). Switches and capacity are left alone unless asked. Every target pack is backed up first.

source.name: Copy from
source.description: Any entity of the pack with the right settings.

targets.name: Copy to
targets.description: Entities of the target packs; empty = all other packs.

keys.name: Only these settings
keys.description: Setting keys, e.g. cell_ovp; empty = all.

dry_run.name: Only show
dry_run.description: Return what would change without writing.

backup_settings.name: Back up settings
backup_settings.description: Saves the settings of a pack (or of every pack, for a bank entity) to a JSON file in config/jk_bms_smart/backups.

restore_settings.name: Restore settings
restore_settings.description: Writes the settings from a backup file back into a pack (administrators only). Only values that differ are written.

entity_id.name: Pack
entity_id.description: Entity of the pack to restore to (a bank entity uses the pack the backup came from).

include_switches.name: Also switches
include_switches.description: Also restore charge / discharge / balance on-off.

dry_run.name: Only show
dry_run.description: Return what would change without writing.

reset_cell_statistics.name: Reset weakest-cell statistics
reset_cell_statistics.description: Starts counting again which cell runs out first, e.g. after replacing or top-balancing cells. Daily history is kept.

create_dashboard.name: Create dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Adds or refreshes the JK BMS Smart dashboard (administrators only).

config_entry_id.name: Battery bank
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one bus.

port_lost.title: JK BMS Smart: RS485 connection lost
port_lost.description: The USB-RS485 adapter or network gateway does not answer ({error}). Check that the stick is plugged in, that no add-on uses the port, and the gateway's power. This message disappears by itself when the connection is back.

pack_offline.title: JK BMS Smart: {pack} sends no data
pack_offline.description: {pack} has not been heard for more than 10 minutes while other packs are. Check the RS485 (parallel) cable between the packs, the DIP address and that the pack is switched on. This message disappears by itself.

settings_mismatch.title: JK BMS Smart: packs have different settings
settings_mismatch.description:
Packs in one bank should protect and balance the same way. Different: {keys}.

Open the JK BMS Smart dashboard → Settings and press **Make equal**, or call the action `jk_bms_smart.copy_settings`. A backup of every pack is made first.
